intro: The club sells physical teaching models and publishes Getting Into Soil & Water.

items.title: Groundwater Flow Model
items.description: A physical model for showing how groundwater moves. The package includes the model, a thermoformed carrying case, an instruction manual, and an accessory kit. The 2026 package price is $795 before shipping. The order form is the current price sheet.

items.title: Getting Into Soil & Water
items.description: The club's annual publication for a general audience. Printed copies are shared at meetings and outreach. A public PDF is not linked here yet.

items.title: Watershed Flow Model
items.description: A watershed built from 24-inch squares. Choose a basin from the club boundary dataset or a pour point, then the square layout and the surface.
